verses.text: Di vision of Obadiah. Dis na wetin di Lord God talk about Edom. We don hear news from di Lord, and dem don send ambassador go among di nations, wey dey talk say, “Rise up! Make we rise up against am for battle.”
“Look, I don make you small among di nations. Dem dey despise you plenty.”
“Your heart pride don deceive you, you wey dey live inside di rock cracks, wey im house dey high, wey dey talk for im heart say, ‘Who go bring me down to di ground?’”
“Even if you climb go up high like di eagle, and even if your nest dey among di stars, I go bring you down from dat place,” na so di Lord talk.
“If thieves come to you, if robbers come for night — how dem don cut you off! — dem no go steal only until dem get enough? If grape pickers come to you, dem no go leave some grapes behind?”
“See how dem go search Esau! See how dem go look for im hidden treasures!”

“All your allies don send you out reach di border. Di men wey dey live at peace with you don deceive you, and don overpower you. Dem wey chop your bread dey set trap under you. Understanding no dey inside am.”
“For dat day, I no go destroy di wise men from Edom, and understanding from Esau mountain?” na so di Lord talk.
“Your mighty men, Teman, go dey afraid, so that everybody go dey cut off from Esau mountain by slaughter.”
“Because of di violence wey you do to your brother Jacob, shame go cover you, and dem go cut you off forever.”
“For di day wey you stand for di other side, for di day wey strangers carry away im wealth, and foreigners enter im gates, and throw lots for Jerusalem, even you dey like one of dem.”
“But no look down on your brother for di day of im disaster, and no rejoice over Judah pikin dem for di day of dem destruction. No talk with pride for di day of distress.”
“No enter my people gate for di day of dem calamity. Yes, no look down on dem suffering for di day of dem calamity, and no grab dem wealth for di day of dem calamity.”
“No stand for di crossroads to cut off im people wey escape. No hand over im people wey remain for di day of distress.”
“For di day of di Lord dey near all di nations. As you don do, na so dem go do to you. Your deeds go return upon your own head.”
“For as you don drink for my holy mountain, so all di nations go dey drink all di time. Yes, dem go drink, and swallow down, and dem go be like say dem no dey before.”
“But for Mount Zion, some go dey wey go escape, and e go dey holy. Jacob house go possess dem possessions.”
“Jacob house go be fire, and Joseph house go be flame, and Esau house go be stubble. Dem go burn among dem, and finish dem. Nobody go remain for Esau house,” because di Lord don talk am.
Dem wey dey South go possess Esau mountain, and dem wey dey di lowland go possess di Philistines. Dem go possess Ephraim field and Samaria field. Benjamin go possess Gilead.
Di captives of dis host of Israel pikin dem, wey dey among di Canaanites, go possess reach Zarephath; and di captives of Jerusalem, wey dey Sepharad, go possess di cities of di South.
Saviors go climb go up Mount Zion to judge Esau mountain. Di kingdom go belong to di Lord.
